content.short: CoinStats is a crypto portfolio tracker that connects wallets, exchanges, DeFi positions, and market data in one dashboard.
content.description: CoinStats is a portfolio tracking platform built to bring wallets, exchanges, DeFi positions, and market data into one view. According to its official app and help center, users can connect hundreds of wallets and exchanges through APIs, public addresses, or manual imports, then monitor balances, profit and loss, allocations, alerts, and watchlists. The product also supports DeFi tracking, portfolio analytics, and wallet based monitoring across many chains, including TON, making it useful for people who want one operating dashboard for their crypto activity.
